title: Paladin: Programmable Privacy for EVM (project site)
quote: Bringing true financial privacy to the world's most popular smart contract platform [...] an LF Decentralized Trust lab [...] Pente [...] Zeto [...] Noto [...] Paladin a Series of LF Projects, LLC [...] works with any unmodified EVM

title: Paladin architecture overview (docs)
quote: Paladin is a privacy preserving transaction manager for Ethereum. [...] Paladin is a sidecar process that runs alongside a Hyperledger Besu node [...] Each smart contract has a part of that runs as a EVM smart contract on an unmodified EVM blockchain, and a part that runs as part of Paladin [...] All use the EVM base ledger as the source of truth for order and finality of transactions [...] All are atomically interoperable via the base EVM ledger

title: Noto - Notarized Tokens (docs)
quote: The Noto domain provides confidential UTXO tokens which are managed by a single party, referred to as the notary. [...] The states are identified on the base ledger only by a hash of the state data [...] The notary will validate [...] Request Authenticity [...] State Validity [...] Conservation of Value [...] none of the basic notary constraints described in the previous section will be active when hooks are configured. [...] The delegated smart contract can perform either of these actions directly on-chain without involvement of the notary.

title: Pente - Private EVM Smart Contracts (docs)
quote: Each smart contract is its own world state. [...] Tessera: Started in 2018, deprecated in 2024 [...] the states diverge so there is no single source of truth [...] Every transaction execution is enforced on-chain, via threshold signature verification [...] No modification to the base EVM [...] Besu EVMs are used to pre-execute EVM transactions [...] These ephemeral EVMs are executed in the Paladin runtime

title: PenteDomain.java (endorsement threshold)
quote: // Only support one string right now for endorsement type. The intention is that more validation options (BLS and/or ZKP based) can be added later. // Note the threshold is 100% right now, as there are architectural considerations for supporting gap-fil of missed transactions for members that miss transitions because they were not required to endorse every transaction.

title: Zeto - Zero Knowledge Proof based tokens (Paladin docs)
quote: Zeto is a UTXO based privacy-preserving token toolkit for EVM, using Zero Knowledge Proofs, implemented via Circom. [...] Tokens indexer [...] Token selector [...] ZK proof generator [...] the following token contracts are supported: Zeto_Anon, Zeto_AnonEnc, Zeto_AnonNullifier

title: Zeto: UTXO based privacy-preserving token toolkit (repository)
quote: Anonymity of sender and receiver [...] Encrypted secrets [...] History masking [...] KYC [...] Non-repudiation with respect to a trusted auditing authority [...] Warning: [...] the proving keys must be generated either in a well-documented, decentralized ceremony, or by one trusted, central party.
